race.title: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: ALL IN YOU looks well treated on his win on softish ground at Sandown last winter and, fit from the Flat, can make a successful return to hurdling under Sean Bowen. Support for Dan Skelton French recruit Lyssenko would make him a potential big threat. Scottish Champion winner Dedicated Hero may prove best of the remainder. ALL IN YOU (FR) LYSSENKO (FR) DEDICATED HERO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Lyssenko (5/4), All In You (5/2), Dedicated Hero (13/2), Manuelito (8/1), Bucephalus (14/1), Star Of Guiting (16/1), King Ulanda (16/1)
